subject.title: fix: restore full release validation on current main

question: Should this coordinated release-validation repair land as one rebased PR after a fresh merged-head Full Release Validation run, or should the startup-metadata refactor be separated from the narrower recovery fixes?
rationale: The branch combines several owner boundaries and currently has a dirty merge state; only maintainers can choose whether its integration benefit outweighs splitting the high-blast-radius metadata refactor.

options.title: Rebase and validate as one repair
options.body: Resolve the current merge state and run the full release matrix plus targeted startup-metadata and upgrade recovery checks on the resulting head.

options.title: Split the metadata refactor
options.body: Land the fixture, lifecycle, and invalid-config recovery fixes separately, then review the generated startup-metadata migration with dedicated integration proof.

recommendation.title: Rebase and validate as one repair
recommendation.body: Resolve the current merge state and run the full release matrix plus targeted startup-metadata and upgrade recovery checks on the resulting head.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch history shows steipete authored the coordinated repair and its latest integration-sensitive startup metadata work.
